R song - a popular R program - Run and see it running real time
"ideone" the online pastebin.

You try running this code and have some fun editing and experimenting
the same and see how it works before you can delve into the nitty-
gritties of more serious coding.

Copy paste the below code and run them on http://ideone.com/ by
choosing R as the language or see the already executed code and the
output at http://ideone.com/Vcx0O which can be edited and run again.

====================================================================

song<-function(n=99) {
a<-" bottle"
b<-" of beer on the wall, "
c<-" of beer. "
d<-"Take one down and pass it around: "
#
## set "beer counter" vector
counter<-c(as.character(n:1),"No more")
#
## set plural
s<-ifelse(counter=="1","","s")
#
## build up the verses vector
firsthalf<-paste(counter,a,s,b,counter,a,s,c,sep="")
sechalf1.99<-paste(d,counter[-1],a,s[-1],b,sep="")
sechalf100<-paste("Go to the store and buy some more: ",
counter[1],a,"s",b,sep="")
##
## song is the vector of n+1 complete verses
song<-paste(firsthalf,c(sechalf1.99,sechalf100),sep="")
}

print(song())
